pages.title: Tigges Family & Ventures | Personal Brand Portfolio
pages.description: Explore Tigges family ventures and professional activities. Discover projects, connections, and updates from the Tigges portfolio. Visit now.

schema-missing.fix: Add JSON-LD for Person (see schema/ templates)
schema-missing.how: Yoast/Rank Math → Settings → Site representation (Organisation / Local business). For a salon: Rank Math Local SEO module or the Yoast Local SEO add-on sets the LocalBusiness subtype, hours and geo. Otherwise paste JSON-LD with a code-snippets plugin (WPCode).

host-canonicalisation.how: Settings → General (WordPress Address + Site Address), plus Cloudways → Domain Management → primary domain and force-HTTPS.

sitemap.fix: Generate an XML sitemap and submit it in GSC/Bing
sitemap.how: Yoast → Settings → Site features → XML sitemaps on. Submit /sitemap_index.xml in Search Console and Bing.

h1.fix: Add exactly one descriptive H1 containing the primary topic
h1.how: Elementor Heading widget → Content → HTML Tag = H1. Make sure the theme isn't also printing the page title as an H1 (Elementor → Page settings → Hide title).

js-only-links.fix: Render navigation and key content server-side so crawlers and AI bots can follow links

extractable-text.fix: AI answers quote text: add concise factual paragraphs (who/what/where/price/hours)

lcp.fix: Compress/preload hero image, cut render-blocking JS
lcp.how: Cloudways: turn on Breeze or Varnish, Object Cache Pro and the Cloudflare Enterprise add-on. Serve the hero as WebP with fetchpriority=high (Elementor → Image → optimise). Remove unused Elementor widgets (Elementor → Features → Improved asset loading).

robots.txt.how: Yoast → Tools → File editor, or upload robots.txt to the web root.

title-length.fix: Aim for 30–60 chars: primary keyword + location/brand
title-length.how: Edit page → Yoast SEO (or Rank Math) panel → SEO title. Site-wide templates are under Yoast → Settings → Content types.

thin-content.fix: Expand with useful, specific text (services, FAQs, proof)
thin-content.how: Add sections in Elementor; Yoast readability/word count helps.

expected-page.fix: Add a dedicated about/bio page and link it from the navigation
expected-page.how: Pages → Add New (Elementor), then add it to Appearance → Menus.

brand-name.fix: Use one exact business name everywhere (site, GBP, directories, schema)
brand-name.how: Settings → General → Site Title, plus Yoast → Site representation → Organisation name.

answer-content.fix: Add an FAQ / Q&A section answering real customer questions (visible text, not just schema)
answer-content.how: Add an FAQ section (Elementor Accordion). It's visible text for AI answers; FAQ rich results no longer show.

og-image.how: Yoast → Social → Facebook image (1200×630). A site default is in Yoast → Settings → Site basics.

llms.txt.fix: Optional: publish /llms.txt (cheap, low evidence of impact)
llms.txt.how: Yoast (v25+) and Rank Math can generate llms.txt, or upload a file to the web root via SFTP (Cloudways → Application → Access details).
